程序包 com.ta.recruitment.service

类 GeminiService

java.lang.Object
com.ta.recruitment.service.GeminiService
public class GeminiService extends Object
Calls the Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API to analyse how well a TA's CV matches a job's requirements, with workload penalty and competition-aware redirection logic built into the prompt.

    • analyzeMatch

      public Application analyzeMatch(String cvContent, String currentJobInfo)
      Convenience overload — no PDF, no workload/competition context.

    • analyzeMatch

      public Application analyzeMatch(String cvContent, String currentJobInfo, byte[] cvPdfBytes, int currentWorkload, int applicantCount, int acceptedCount, int openings, boolean applyWorkloadPenalty, String otherAvailableJobs)
      Analyses CV-to-job fit.

      Workload overload (>80 h) is evaluated locally: if applyWorkloadPenalty is true (MO side) a strong warning is injected into the prompt asking the AI to deduct points; on the TA side it is ignored.

      Competition (applicants > openings*2) never adds a prompt warning — the AI is simply given the other-jobs list and asked to recommend an alternative.

      参数:
      applyWorkloadPenalty - true = MO side (deduct for overload); false = TA side (no deduction)

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Extreme test case: candidate is already at 45 h workload (above 40 h threshold) AND the target position is completely full (3 accepted out of 3 needed), with a high applicant-to-accepted ratio. Expect: - workload penalty applied in aiMatchScore - aiReasoning mentions overload - aiRecommendedAlternativeJob points to a less-contested opening Before running: set GEMINI_API_KEY env var, or replace the constant above.
